text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for your hard work! 
Let's do our best tomorrow too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Laurel-san! Did you just finish up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"We thought we'd try training with the 
Victory Method for the first time in a 
while!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This is the training menu we used to do at 
Victory Club!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back! When things got tough 
toward the end, we'd all cheer each other 
on..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'm feeling great today. Maybe I 
can do a little more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! May I go try out the Victory 
Method too?
choice_data_list:
I don't mind if I'm doing it together with 
the two of you.
You should take the rest of the day off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Please rest assured! We'll keep a close 
eye on Ms. Laurel!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We've been working together all this time, 
after all. If something's wrong, I can 
tell right away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Baku-chan and Chiyo-chan! Well 
then, shall we get started?

Sakura Laurel dedicated herself to extra 
training alongside her old friends.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: It's a shame, but... it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. We'd be happy to keep you 
company anytime.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So Laurel-san, please get plenty of 
rest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll do that. Thank you, Baku-chan, 
Chiyo-chan!

Sakura Laurel made a promise to the two of 
them, wrapping up that day's training.
